Luna claimed to be the real officer on day two and called Terra a killer, and Sonnet voted Luna out when that claim collapsed. Terra then claimed officer and said she had checked Sol as a killer, but Sol called the checks convenient and never counterclaimed. Sol and Terra tied twice on day three, so nobody left, and Terra was killed on night four. The killers won, with Sol hiding behind Luna's fake claim, and Gemma, the citizen, spent day one as everyone's punching bag.
